reviews.text: Joyce is great, she was very careful, attentive and loving with my kittens.

I highly recommend Joy's cat sitter services to anyone looking for peace of mind when traveling without their cats. She is very responsible and concerned about their well-being, committed to schedules, and puts owners at ease even when away. She also sends lots of videos to ease the longing 😊 On top of that, she managed two miracles: winning over my wary cat on the first visit and giving my grumpy cat his medicine every time. I found her through Google and she's already become Leon and Duna's official cat sitter 😍 Thank you Joy for the fantastic work!
Very attentive and careful with our cats! Always updates with photos and videos :)
Joyce is an excellent professional, she took care of my kitten for a week, always sending lots of videos and photos! Highly recommended!
Joyce is wonderful! Super careful, attentive, and loving. My kitten feels completely comfortable.

Joyce took great care of my cats while I was traveling. Even one of my cats, who is quite timid and always hides, ended up feeling safe and allowing herself to be cared for by her.
She kept me updated with photos and videos during her visits, and I felt at ease being away knowing they were being very well taken care of! I recommend her!

Joy is an amazing person!!

Super careful and attentive with our senior cats.

She was very responsible and loving with them! She always sent us photos and videos of them, and she was always giving them attention and affection ❤️

And she even left a super sweet note!!

Thank you, Joy, for all the care you gave our babies! We will definitely contact you on our next trip!!
I had a worry-free two-week trip because Joy took care of my three cats every day with great affection and attention. I wholeheartedly recommend her work; she's super professional and caring.
Very good! I highly recommend it :) Joy is very attentive and careful.

Excellent pet sitter: punctual, responsible, and caring. Mel, who is already an elderly dog ​​with cognitive impairment, was very calm in her lap. Joy sent pictures of the time she spent with Mel at home, which reassured me greatly.
Excellent experience! Very attentive, careful, and loving with the pets. She inspired a lot of confidence and maintained good communication throughout the entire period. I definitely recommend her!
Joyce has immense dedication and affection for animals and treats them as if they were her own! I highly recommend her services! My cat Lika was very well cared for and pampered by her for 10 days!
Joy was amazing!! I needed someone to take care of my cat for several days and I had complete confidence that he was being well cared for, with daily photos and videos. I highly recommend her! :)

I'm a very demanding pet mom, and I was very satisfied with Joy's work (and her as a person), from the initial in-person conversation we had, which is a very important point for me—making those adjustments and getting to know the person who will be in my home in my absence—to the care she gave my little girl. I received daily updates on how she was doing, and that reassured me a lot during the trip. For anyone looking for a trustworthy person to take care of their beloved pet, I recommend her work. I will certainly contact her again in the future. Thank you so much, Joy!

Joy was extremely careful with our pets, we have 5! She sent photos and videos of all the visits, was super meticulous with health care and even medicated our dog who takes medicine daily. I highly recommend her.
100% took great care of our cats. And he was very professional.

Joy Pet Sitter took care of my two kittens with great affection, attention, and dedication. She managed to win them both over, including the shyest one, which made me feel even more at ease during the trip. She is an extremely responsible, careful, and affectionate professional. I was very happy to have found her, I recommend her with complete confidence, and I will certainly use her services again on future trips.

I felt relieved knowing that the cat was taken care of warmly while I was away. The cat is usually very shy and afraid of people, but the professional touch must have made a difference.☺️

I will entrust my cat to them again next time.

I recommend her without hesitation! Joy took care of our kittens for 21 days, was extremely loving and caring throughout, sent photos, videos, and updates daily, and it was noticeable that the animals were super comfortable with her. My mother and I felt very safe leaving the kittens in her care. Thank you so much, Joy! We recommend her 10/10!!!

Good afternoon! Joyce is an excellent professional. Very attentive, dedicated, and loves animals. She is gentle with the animals and very sweet. We have 7 kittens, and one of them takes daily medication; she took very good care of him and the other 6 who were with him. We were traveling for 30 days, and every day she sent videos, photos, and audio messages, which made my daughter and I very comfortable during the trip. I highly recommend Joyce's services. We were very happy.

I hired Joy without knowing many people in São Paulo and had an excellent experience. She took great care of my cats. They were calm throughout my trip and really liked her.

Furthermore, I felt much more secure because she kept me updated every day, always with photos and news about them. I highly recommend her!
Joy is wonderful and takes great care of my daughter. I highly recommend her!
I highly recommend it! I was away for 2 weeks and was able to relax completely, knowing my cats were being well taken care of 💕 …

Joyce is super attentive. I'm from São Caetano and I preferred to hire her for my pets' care, even though she's from Vila Mariana, because of the professionalism and trust she instilled in me from the very first contact.
Joyce is amazing! My cat loved her! She provides incredible reassurance, with photos and videos of how your pet is doing ☺️

Joyce is an extremely competent, caring, and patient person. During the visit, she asked very relevant questions, and I felt very confident. I have an elderly cat who needs care with medication, and she was simply amazing and super sweet.

I highly recommend her!
I loved my experience with Joyce! I highly recommend her. Very careful, calm, and punctual. 10 out of 10!!

Joy took care of Leon for 4 days, coming to the house twice a day for walks and to take care of everything he needed. She was extremely professional, easy to communicate with, and always sent updates. Thank you, Joy! We hope to count on you again soon.

Just gratitude for all the care and affection Joyce showed our kittens. Everything was organized, the cats were well cared for, and she even left a note showing her affection for the pets!!! Thank you again, Aunt Joyce!!!

My experience with Joyce was great. It was an emergency situation and the response was quick. She is careful at every stage of the process, loving with animals, discreet, and capable. I will definitely use her services again in the future.

My experience leaving my kitten with Joy was wonderful because, in addition to caring for her with the utmost love, she made me feel completely at ease about leaving my kitten in someone else's care for the first time. I can only express my gratitude and say that you can rest assured that your pet will be well cared for while in her care.
We left our kittens in Joyce's care during our vacation; she was careful, professional, and super loving! They were very well taken care of.
Extremely kind and trustworthy. He took very good care of our Belinha during the agreed-upon period. I recommend him to the entire community!
I appreciate the services provided by dear Joyce. She took excellent care of my kitten, sending videos and photos. I highly recommend her. 10 out of 10!
Joyce took great care of my kittens over the New Year, she was attentive to all our whims, haha, she sent photos and got everything organized! Thank you Joyce ♡
Joyce is attentive and careful! I arrived from my trip and everything was organized, my kitten was calm. Every day I received updates with photos and videos. He was very well taken care of!
Joyce was very attentive to my chihuahua puppy, sending photos and videos of all the visits and even cleaning my sofa when my pet ended up peeing outside the training pad.

Joy was an excellent petsitter and took great care of my babies. She updated me daily with photos and videos, and when I arrived they were fine and everything was very clean and organized. On top of everything, I even found this super cute little note ❤️
A wonderful professional and person! She took care of my kitten and kept me updated, I highly recommend her 💗 …

Joy is a sweetheart, extremely professional and caring with the dogs. I took a business trip that lasted longer than we had planned, and Joy provided all the support for me, always keeping me updated on how Fred and Jujuba were doing, and taking very good care of them and my house as well.

I highly recommend Joy's service. 🥰
